A user who cannot edit billable rates cannot move a project onto a money budget, and cannot change any budget field of a project that is already budgeted by money — including turning that budget off. notify_when_over_budget.description: Whether Project Managers should be notified when the project goes over budget. Defaults to false.

project_id.description: Required. The project to add, taken from the request body only. A value that is not a plain integer returns 422; a project that does not exist, belongs to another account, is archived, or is outside the caller's write scope returns 404.

color.description: Optional. The project's board colour: green, lime, yellow, brown, aqua, blue, indigo, purple, magenta, or gray. null or "" clears it, and omitting the key leaves the existing colour alone.

actions.name: remove_project_from_board
actions.description: Remove a project from the board. Beta endpoint. Fully available, but the response shape may still change. Until it is frozen, every response includes Harvest-Api-Stability: beta.

project_id.description: The project's id

actions.name: set_project_board_colour
actions.description: Set a project's board colour. Beta endpoint. Fully available, but the response shape may still change. Until it is frozen, every response includes Harvest-Api-Stability: beta.

project_id.description: The project's id

color.description: Required. The body key must be present. One of green, lime, yellow, brown, aqua, blue, indigo, purple, magenta or gray to set the colour; null or "" to clear it.

actions.name: get_availability_heatmap
actions.description: Availability Heatmap. Beta endpoint. Fully available, but the response shape may still change. Until it is frozen, every response includes Harvest-Api-Stability: beta.

from.description: Inclusive first day of the window. Send it with to, or send neither. (YYYY-MM-DD)

to.description: Inclusive last day of the window. Send it with from, or send neither. The window cannot span more than 24 months. (YYYY-MM-DD)

scale.description: The bucket size: daily (default), weekly, or monthly.

includes.description: Pass tracked_hours to add actual tracked hours to every bucket on a person row. It is the only value accepted. Actuals are reported weekly and monthly only, so scale=daily with includes=tracked_hours is served as weekly.

page.description: The page number to use in pagination. (Default: 1)

per_page.description: The number of assignees to return per page. Can range between 1 and 2000. (Default: 200)
